name: Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd.
summary: Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd. operates amusement parks, hotels, golf courses, ski resorts, outdoor and travel businesses, and campgrounds in Japan. The company engages in the transportation, tourism, distribution services, real estate, civil engineering and construction, and information technology businesses. It also offers transportation services, including Fujikyu railway and bus, share-ride buses, highway buses, reserved buses, etc., as well as real estate services, such as building leasing, condo/villa subdivision, etc. In addition, the company offers accommodation services. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
